name: After § 43
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 43b. Stresses that Parliament’s drivers perform an essential role in the functioning of the institution and in transporting Members and other authorised persons; notes that their working conditions, their knowledge of security requirements and their potential access to confidential information concerning the institution’s movements and activities require specific safeguards; considers that outsourcing these functions could undermine service continuity, the ability to ensure compliance with security requirements and the confidentiality inherent in these duties; accordingly calls for Parliament’s driver services to remain in-house and opposes any outsourcing of these functions;
